findings.title: OpenMage LTS advisory GHSA-pqgf-g7m7-vh98: Stored XSS in the admin order view via an unescaped guest checkout email address
findings.summary_md: The advisory says the admin order view echoes a guest customer email unescaped into the copy-to-clipboard attribute at `app/design/adminhtml/base/default/template/sales/order/view/info.phtml` line 111, so a crafted address can run script when an administrator opens the order or its invoice, shipment or credit memo pages. It lists affected ranges 20.7.0 through 20.18.2, 20.19.0 before 20.19.1 and 21.0.0-beta2 before 21.0.0-beta4, patched in 20.18.3, 20.19.1 and 21.0.0-beta4. It rates the issue Critical 9.3 with vector CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N, credits @raylitebull through HackerOne and states that no CVE is known.

findings.title: OpenMage Magento LTS v20.19.1 security release
findings.summary_md: The release notes say v20.19.1 fixes 12 security issues, six with CVE identifiers requested and six published only as GitHub Security Advisories, and that the same fixes ship in v20.18.3 and v21.0.0-beta4. The guest-checkout email stored XSS GHSA-pqgf-g7m7-vh98 is listed first at Critical 9.3 with a CVE requested and fixed in 20.18.3 and 20.19.1. The notes advise upgrading as soon as possible and flag several issues where restricted admin roles can reach data or code execution outside their scope.

findings.title: OpenMage Magento LTS v20.18.3 security-only patch release
findings.summary_md: The v20.18.3 notes describe a security-only patch release on top of v20.18.2 that fixes all twelve issues in the wave. Their advisory table lists GHSA-pqgf-g7m7-vh98 as Critical 9.3 with a CVE requested, fixed in 20.18.3 and 20.19.1. The release says the same fixes ship in v20.19.1 and that the new unit tests are adapted to PHPUnit 9.

findings.title: OpenMage Magento LTS v21.0.0-beta4 pre-release security fixes
findings.summary_md: The 21.x pre-release notes say v21.0.0-beta4 merges the v20.19.1 security release and carries the same 12 security fixes. They list GHSA-pqgf-g7m7-vh98 at Critical 9.3 fixed in 21.0.0-beta4, alongside the other advisories from v20.19.1. The notes say dependency versions were aligned with v20.19.1.
